note: The central PARADOXES and the PUNCTUMS of Ada Research's texts, made into stickers (2026-11-13). Seven readers read the walked prose (final.md), the wall texts and the framework and returned 112 candidates, each quote checked word for word; a truth critic and a sticker critic judged them in context; these 28 were chosen by hand, one per shared tension, across the spine. A paradox is two things a text holds true at once (a, b: the badge's paper and ink halves); a punctum (Barthes) is the detail that pricks (a: the caption under its photograph). 'quote' must stay word for word in 'file' or tools/stickers_seed.ts stops; 'line' is a reader's hint. Drawn by ada_encyclopedia src/lib/sticker-starter.ts (READING_MOTIFS[motif]).

readings.a: A compass can draw any circle
readings.b: and cannot draw its way out of the plane
readings.quote: A compass can draw any circle and cannot draw its way out of the plane.

readings.a: Mathematics never gets there.
readings.quote: The machine reaches the limit by running out of digits. Mathematics never gets there. Floats do, by forgetting.

readings.a: Nobody drew the amphora.
readings.quote: Nobody drew the amphora. Somebody chose a stiffness, a pinned collar, an initial expansion and a number of steps, and the amphora is what those choices left.

readings.a: Everything worked,
readings.quote: Everything worked, and this happened.

readings.a: The place is the same.
readings.quote: Returning to a place need not mean returning to the same moment in a movement. The place is the same. The state is not.

readings.a: A crossing can repeat
readings.quote: Your knowledge survives the reset. A crossing can repeat while the person crossing it cannot return to not knowing.

readings.a: Zero total length
readings.quote: Its limiting set has zero total length and uncountably many points.

readings.a: Being present
readings.b: and being counted have parted company
readings.quote: Only the active state, numbered one, contributes to the count. A green neighbour holds state two. Being present and being counted have parted company.

readings.a: Their letters have not changed.
readings.quote: Their letters have not changed. Each still carries five drawing instructions, yet the same route through the symbols takes another route through space.

readings.a: The numbers return
readings.quote: Restore the settings while the cube is moving. It continues from where it has arrived. The numbers return sooner than the body.

readings.a: The sphere disappears from view
readings.quote: the sphere disappears from view while its contour remains in the other body. Absence has been given a surface.

readings.a: You moved.
readings.quote: A movement nobody quite made ... The recording has an occasion: you moved. The mean has a calculation.

readings.a: Adding the sentence moves the gap up.
readings.quote: A pulse climbs it and finds the gap again on every level. Adding the sentence moves the gap up. It does not close it.

readings.a: The closed leaf lets you pass.
readings.b: Turn back: it is still there.
readings.quote: Walk through. The closed leaf lets you pass. Turn back: it is still there.

readings.a: My first number was not its first number.
readings.quote: The number has moved on. My first number was not its first number.

readings.a: Three cones around nothing.
readings.quote: Three cones around nothing. There was a hole here, in the code, and it is no longer drawn; the cordon stayed.

readings.a: I press my thumb … once, to see if that was it.
readings.quote: At the opening I press my thumb against the side of my finger, once, to see if that was it.

readings.a: A rather poor marker … but I know where to look.
readings.quote: I put the black point approximately where the white one was. When I release it, the light goes out. It makes a rather poor marker in this light, but I know where to look.

readings.a: Even the black corner has been brightened slightly
readings.quote: Even the black corner has been brightened slightly so that you can find it.

readings.a: The hand … is already wearing the last one.
readings.quote: Reach for the point again. The hand making the next choice is already wearing the last one.

readings.a: Even the one in your hand.
readings.quote: Each point keeps at most twenty. After that, a new arrival makes one of its cubes disappear, chosen at random—even the one in your hand. The heap keeps changing without a record. What you were holding is no exception to its rule.

readings.a: No fading gives it a farewell.
readings.quote: Wait with one mark. It is there, then absent. No fading gives it a farewell.

readings.a: The same address from a little lower down.
readings.quote: When the surface gives way, you are still looking at the same address from a little lower down.

readings.a: The alloy without its tears.
readings.quote: The last body is a cube of a metal the header calls sad, with streaks that were meant to run down it like tears. ... What you see is the alloy without its tears.

readings.a: Look for a mouth.
readings.quote: Its surface can meet your body; transparency has not made it passable. Look for a mouth.

readings.a: Add a ring … The number has not moved.
readings.quote: Add a ring to the leader. Look through its opening, then back at the score. A conspicuous part has appeared. The number has not moved.

readings.a: The hand has arrived. Your hand is missing.
readings.quote: The hand has arrived. Your hand is missing.

readings.a: There is still a saw on the table.
readings.quote: One person takes the drill. The other waits. There is still a saw on the table.
